Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Psychology BA at Stanford University

What Stanford University asks of applicants to Psychology BA for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All Stanford University courses · Psychology & Social Sciences field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • ACT or SAT required — first-year applicants
  • No minimum test scores; scores are self-reported in the application (official scores required only on enrolment)

Stanford’s testing page notes ACT/SAT scores were optional for the Class of 2029; the current page (updated July 2026) states they are required. Stanford publishes middle-50% scores of the Class of 2029, which are not requirements. Stanford’s first-year requirements apply to all applicants, whatever the intended major.

Verified19 Oct 2026Stanford: Standardized Testing (first-year) · Stanford: International Applicants
English language
  • No English proficiency exam required; applicants may self-report scores from any English proficiency exam
  • Fluency in English is a prerequisite for admission
  • English proficiency tests cannot substitute for the ACT/SAT requirement
Verified19 Oct 2026Stanford: International Applicants · Stanford: Standardized Testing (first-year)
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

No course-specific admissions test; the required tests are the ACT or SAT, for all first-year applicants.

Verified19 Oct 2026Stanford: First-Year Requirements and Deadlines
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: Stanford has no required courses for admission. Its recommended high-school curriculum (stated as recommendations, not requirements) is English four years; mathematics four years, including calculus; history/social studies at least three years; science at least three years; world language at least three years of the same language. Applies to all applicants, not major-specific.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Stanford: Preparing for Stanford Academics
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
Students in the British education system are required to have a school official send GCSE results and predicted A-Level marks for consideration. Stanford says applicants from this system generally will have taken at least three full A-Level courses; it has no preference for a specific curriculum.

Stanford states no A-Level grade requirement and no minimum scores.

Verified19 Oct 2026Stanford: Standardized Testing (first-year) · Stanford: International Applicants
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
Students enrolled in an IB Diploma programme outside the U.S. are required to have a school official send predicted IB marks (including TOK/essay bonus points). Stanford has no preference for a specific curriculum.

Stanford states no IB points requirement and no minimum scores.

Verified19 Oct 2026Stanford: Standardized Testing (first-year) · Stanford: International Applicants
Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: AP exams are not mandatory, but all AP scores taken (including self-studied) must be self-reported in the application
Verified19 Oct 2026Stanford: Standardized Testing (first-year)
Other requirements
  • Interview:
    • optional
    • offered by alumni volunteers depending on availability in your area — the application is complete with or without one
  • Arts Portfolio (Art Practice, Dance, Music, Theater and Performance Studies): optional
  • Letters of recommendation from two academic teachers required
